Nifty, Sensex & Market Indices

Learn what market indices represent and why investors follow them.

What is an index?

An index tracks a selected group of securities using a defined methodology. It can be used as a benchmark for a market or segment.

Why indices matter

  • Provide a broad market reference.
  • Help compare portfolio performance.
  • Support diversified index-based products.
  • Help learners understand market trends at a broad level.
